guard: the kernel exits a classified failure by its outcome and writes its envelope on --json, reports an unclassified error from a structured command as unknown, keeps a usage error under --json to one envelope, makes --json imply --no-input, version --json labels an unreadable extension list partial, and no command may declare a global flag's name
why: The kernel is where a command's failure becomes an exit code and a document. Each mutation restores one way that mapping can drift, and must redden the assertion that names it. The suite imports the CLI source directly, so no rebuild is needed.

mutations.name: an unclassified error from a structured command exits 1
mutations.expectRed: an unclassified error from a structured command exits 3
mutations.cell: an unclassified error from a structured command exits 3

mutations.name: a usage error under --json prints help instead of an envelope
mutations.expectRed: a usage error under --json is one USAGE_INVALID envelope
mutations.cell: a usage error under --json is one USAGE_INVALID envelope

mutations.name: -j in a group of short flags is not read
mutations.expectRed: -j inside a group of short flags asks for the usage envelope
mutations.cell: -j inside a group of short flags asks for the usage envelope

mutations.name: global flags after the command word reach its parser
mutations.expectRed: --no-input after the command's words disables input
mutations.cell: --no-input after the command's words disables input

mutations.name: an unreadable manifest is reported complete
mutations.expectRed: an unreadable manifest makes the read partial, not empty and complete
mutations.cell: an unreadable manifest makes the read partial, not empty and complete

mutations.name: a connect refusal from a structured command is reported unknown
mutations.find: if (isConnectRefusal(e)) failureExit(cmd, inOperationSpace(e.failure(), scope.space), json, parsed.values.plain === true);
mutations.expectRed: a connect refusal from a structured command exits 2
mutations.cell: a connect refusal from a structured command exits 2

mutations.name: an unresolvable target from a structured command is reported unknown
mutations.find:
if (isWorkspaceTargetError(e)) {
        const { message, remedy } = workspaceErrorParts({ kind: "target", error: e });
mutations.replace:
if (isWorkspaceTargetError(e) && String(e.code) === "\u0000never") {
        const { message, remedy } = workspaceErrorParts({ kind: "target", error: e });

mutations.name: a space catalog that stopped a structured command is reported unknown
mutations.find: if (e instanceof CatalogPreparationError) failureExit(cmd, new CommandFailure("refused", e.code, e.message), json, parsed.values.plain === true);
mutations.expectRed: a space catalog that stopped the command exits 2
mutations.cell: a space catalog that stopped the command exits 2

mutations.name: an unanswered read is not classified
mutations.expectRed: an unanswered read is an unavailable target
mutations.cell: an unanswered read is an unavailable target

mutations.name: a denied read is not classified
a read failure nothing classifies is unknown
mutations.find: return code ? new CommandFailure("refused", code, message, opts) : new CommandFailure("failed", "OPERATION_FAILED", message, opts);
mutations.replace: return code ? new CommandFailure("refused", code, message, opts) : new CommandFailure("unknown", "OPERATION_UNKNOWN", message, opts);
mutations.expectRed: a read that failed for an unclassified reason is failed, not unknown
mutations.cell: a read that failed for an unclassified reason is failed, not unknown

mutations.name: a command may declare a global flag
mutations.expectRed: a command that declares a global flag is an internal error that exits 1
mutations.cell: a command that declares a global flag is an internal error that exits 1
